content: क्षेपः [क्षिप्-घञ्] .²1 Throwing, tossing, casting, moving about, movement (of limbs); कुन्दक्षेपानुगम <ls>Me. 49</ls>; भ्रूक्षेपमात्रानुमतप्रवेशाम् <ls>Ku. 3. 60</ls>. .²2 A throw, cast. .²3 Sending, dispatching. .²4 Depression; striking down. .²5 Transgressing. .²6 Passing away (time); कालक्षेपः. .²7 Delay, dilatoriness. .²8 Insult, abuse; क्षेपं संप्राप्तवांस्तत्र <ls>Rām. 12. 49. 56</ls>; क्षेपं करोति चेद्दण्डयः <ls>Y. 2. 204</ls>; किं क्षेपे. <ls>P. II. 1. 64</ls>. .²9 Disrespect, contempt. .²10 Pride, haughtiness. .²11 A nosegay. .²12 A stroke (of an oar <ab>&c.</ab>). .²13 Laying on (as a paint <ab>&c.</ab>), besmearing. .²14 (in <ab>arith.</ab>) Addendum. .²15 The astronomical latitude; <ls>Golādh.</ls>
